plugin.summary: Books, audiobooks, comics and manga from open catalogs
page.status.label: Books catalog
kind.books.label: Books
kind.audiobooks.label: Audiobooks
settings.hardcover_token.label: Hardcover API token
settings.hardcover_token.help: Optional token from your Hardcover account for community ratings, trending reads and series.
settings.enable_openlibrary.label: Open Library catalog
settings.enable_openlibrary.help: Include trending books, curated genre shelves, author portraits and live search from Open Library.
settings.enable_audible_metadata.label: Audible audiobook catalog
settings.enable_audible_metadata.help: Include audiobook metadata, narrators, series order, runtimes and square covers from the public Audible catalog API.
settings.enable_standard_ebooks.label: Standard Ebooks classics
settings.enable_standard_ebooks.help: Include carefully typeset public-domain EPUB editions ready to read immediately.
settings.enable_librivox.label: LibriVox audiobooks
settings.enable_librivox.help: Include free public-domain audiobooks with chapter-by-chapter audio playback.
settings.enable_gutenberg.label: Project Gutenberg catalog
settings.enable_gutenberg.help: Include additional public-domain books from Gutendex when available.
settings.language.label: Catalog language
settings.language.help: Filter curated shelves and live search results by language.
settings.catalog_size.label: Catalog depth
settings.catalog_size.help: Control how many titles are synced across curated Home shelves.
settings.ebook_categories.label: Book indexer categories
settings.ebook_categories.help: Comma-separated Newznab categories searched for ebook releases.
settings.audiobook_categories.label: Audiobook indexer categories
settings.audiobook_categories.help: Comma-separated Newznab categories searched for audiobook releases.
settings.prefer_unabridged.label: Require unabridged audiobooks
settings.prefer_unabridged.help: Reject abridged releases when resolving unabridged audiobook editions.
settings.prefer_cached.label: Prefer cached debrid releases
settings.prefer_cached.help: Rank already-cached debrid releases ahead of uncached torrents.
settings.contact_email.label: Contact email for Open Library
settings.contact_email.help: Optional email included in the User-Agent header per Open Library API guidelines.
view.status.title: Books and audiobooks
view.status.subtitle: Curated books and audiobooks catalog
view.status.notice_cleared: Metadata cache cleared. Next library sync will refresh all shelves.
kind.comics.label: Comics & Manga
settings.enable_manga.label: Sync manga
settings.enable_manga.help: Manga, manhwa and manhua from AniList, free and with no account needed.
settings.manga_titles.label: Manga series to sync
settings.manga_titles.help: How many AniList series to list, each with its volumes, from 20 to 1000.
settings.manga_order.label: Which manga
settings.manga_order.help: The most popular series, what is trending now, or the newest series first.
settings.include_adult_manga.label: Include adult manga
settings.include_adult_manga.help: Also list series AniList marks as adult.
settings.enable_mangaupdates.label: Volume counts from MangaUpdates
settings.enable_mangaupdates.help: Ask MangaUpdates how many volumes an ongoing series has when AniList does not say.
settings.volumes_per_series.label: Volumes or issues per series
settings.volumes_per_series.help: The most volumes listed for one manga series, or newest issues for one comic series.
settings.metron_username.label: Metron username
settings.metron_username.help: Your free Metron account, needed for Western comics.
settings.metron_password.label: Metron password
settings.metron_password.help: The password of that Metron account.
settings.comic_series.label: Comic series to follow
settings.comic_series.help: Series names such as Batman or Saga, add a year in brackets to pick one run, as in Batman (2016).
settings.comic_new_weeks.label: New comic issues, in weeks
settings.comic_new_weeks.help: Also list every comic released in the last few weeks, 0 to turn it off.
settings.comics_categories.label: Comics indexer categories
settings.comics_categories.help: Newznab category IDs searched for comics and manga releases.
